metadata.title: MoSPI ProjectPulse Master Infrastructure Showcase Dataset
metadata.agency: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
features_included: Contractor Due Diligence & Ghost Billing Verification

projects.name: National Highway Expansion Corridor
projects.description: 4-lane highway expansion connecting key industrial nodes across Assam.

projects.name: Rural Water Supply Network
projects.description: Piped water distribution covering 120 rural habitations under Jal Jeevan Mission.

projects.name: Digital Governance & Citizen Portal
projects.description: State-wide centralized public service delivery and grievance redressal platform.

projects.name: Urban Development & Drainage Mission
projects.description: Stormwater drainage, sewage trunk lines, and road widening across municipal wards.

projects.name: Power Transmission Grid Expansion
projects.description: High-voltage 132kV transmission corridors connecting eastern mountain clusters.

projects.name: Border Area Road Connectivity
projects.description: Strategic border connectivity road passing through high-altitude tunnels and bridges.

projects.name: District Hospital Upgradation
projects.description: Upgrading district civil hospital with 200 ICU beds, diagnostic labs, and oxygen plant.

projects.name: Rail Infrastructure Modernization - Demo
projects.description: Double-tracking, signalling overhaul, and grade separation across critical regional rail trunk lines.

projects.name: Flood Management & River Embankment
projects.description: Geo-textile reinforced embankment and sluice gate control structures along vulnerable Brahmaputra stretches.

projects.name: Smart City Connectivity & OFC Backbone
projects.contractor_name: Shadow Ridge Mega Projects Pvt Ltd
projects.description: Underground optical fibre backbone network connecting urban local bodies and rural administrative blocks.

projects.name: Greenfield Expressway Freight Corridor
projects.description: 6-lane controlled-access freight highway reducing inter-state transit times by 40%.

projects.name: Deepwater Coastal Transshipment Port Rail Link
projects.description: Dedicated heavy-haul railway evacuation link connecting dock berths to the main freight line.

projects.name: Ultra-Mega Solar Power Park
projects.description: 500MW photovoltaic utility power generation field with automated tracking bifacial panels.

projects.name: Inland Waterways Cargo Terminal
projects.description: Multimodal cargo jetty on National Waterway 1 with bulk grain handling conveyor systems.

projects.name: Semi-High Speed Vande Bharat Maintenance Depot
projects.description: State-of-the-art automated bogie testing, washing plant, and overnight trainset maintenance bays.

projects.name: AI National Computing Grid Facility
projects.description: Tier-IV green data center housing high-performance GPU clusters for sovereign AI workloads.

projects.name: Desalination Plant & Potable Water Pipeline
projects.description: 100 MLD sea water reverse osmosis desalination plant and 65km cross-country conveyance conduit.

projects.name: AIIMS Tertiary Healthcare Super-Specialty Block
projects.description: 750-bed apex tertiary research hospital with trauma care and advanced oncology surgical wings.

projects.name: Multimodal Logistics Park & Inland Container Depot
projects.description: Mechanized warehouse clusters, cold storage chain, and rail-siding transshipment yard.

projects.name: Border Surveillance Tower Network
projects.description: High-altitude border electro-optic sensor masts, thermal surveillance, and solar hybrid backup power.

contractors.name: Shadow Ridge Mega Projects Pvt Ltd
